response.justification: Bogdan is a broadly experienced, versatile engineer with strong systems, tooling, and developer-experience instincts (including prior work on a C IDE at National Instruments and building test frameworks/runners in D). However, the role requires deep, current Java/Kotlin and JVM expertise plus solid Spring/enterprise framework experience, and the resume shows almost none of that: Java appears only as a peripheral skill listed once from a 2016-2018 role, with no Kotlin, Spring, Quarkus, Hibernate, Gradle/Maven, or application-server work anywhere. The last decade is dominated by TypeScript/Node, D, and full-stack product work, so the core technical requirements are largely unmet despite the general seniority.
strengths: Prior IDE/developer-tooling experience (LabWindows/CVI, test runners, MCP codegen)
Strong engineering practices: TDD, CI/CD, pairing, testable architecture
Low-latency, high-throughput systems experience and multi-language versatility
concerns: No demonstrated Kotlin, Spring, Quarkus, or Hibernate experience
Java exposure is minimal, peripheral, and roughly a decade old
Recent career trajectory is web/full-stack TypeScript, not JVM platform work
